name: Figure Cards
description: Headline numbers in cards, each with an icon, a change from last period and an optional explanation.

props.name: label
props.description: What the number counts, shown muted beside the icon. Also names the card.

props.name: value
props.description: The number, already formatted, e.g. "12,840" or "1.94M".

props.name: delta
props.description: Change since the last period as a signed fraction: 0.16 shows 16% up.

props.name: invertDelta
props.description: Treats a fall as good, for numbers like churn or cost. The arrow still points the way the number moved.

props.name: deltaDigits
props.description: Most decimal places in the change.

props.name: icon
props.description: A 16 pixel icon, shown in a small tile before the label.

props.name: variant
props.description: Chip puts the change beside the value. Band moves it into a muted footer with the comparison text.

props.name: info
props.description: Explains the number. Shows an info button at the top right with this text in a tooltip.

props.name: comparison
props.description: Text on the left of the footer band.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the card. Also accepts every other div attribute.

props.name: children
props.description: FigureCard elements. They share the row evenly, wrap onto more rows when narrow, and match heights.

props.name: minCardWidth
props.description: Narrowest a card may get before the row wraps.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the grid, e.g. a max width. Also accepts every other div attribute.
